events.label: birth
events.text: Born in Kamloops, British Columbia.

evidence.quote: born in Kamloops , British Columbia , on April 30 , 1908

events.text: Joined the Royal Canadian Air Force at Camp Borden as pilot officer.

evidence.quote: joined the Royal Canadian Air Force at Camp Borden on September 15 , 1931

events.text: Received his wings and was promoted to flying officer.

evidence.quote: He received his wings on December 16 and was promoted to flying officer

events.text: Became instructor at the Camp Borden flying and navigation school.

evidence.quote: becoming an instructor at the Camp Borden flying and navigation school in 1935

events.text: Began teaching at Air Navigation and Seaplane School, Trenton.

evidence.quote: he taught at the Air Navigation and Seaplane School , Trenton from May 1937 to September 1938

events.text: Promoted to flight lieutenant.

evidence.quote: flight lieutenant on September 1 , 1937

events.text: Ended teaching at Air Navigation and Seaplane School, Trenton.

evidence.quote: he taught at the Air Navigation and Seaplane School , Trenton from May 1937 to September 1938

events.text: Posted to England to attend the Specialist Air Navigation Course at RAF Manston.

evidence.quote: In September 1938 , Miller was posted to England to attend the Specialist Air Navigation Course

events.text: Promoted to squadron leader.

evidence.quote: promoted to squadron leader on April 1 , 1939

events.text: Became Officer Commanding of the Air Navigation and Reconnaissance School, Trenton.

evidence.quote: At the outbreak of war in September , Miller was the Officer Commanding of the Air Navigation and Reconnaissance School , Trenton

events.text: Promoted to acting wing commander.

evidence.quote: He was promoted to acting wing commander in December 1940

events.text: Commanded the Air Navigation School at Rivers, Manitoba.

evidence.quote: From May 1942 Miller commanded the Air Navigation School at Rivers , Manitoba

events.text: Promoted to acting group captain.

evidence.quote: Promoted to acting group captain in July

events.text: Became Director of Training Plans and Requirements at Air Force Headquarters.

evidence.quote: moving to the Air Force Headquarters in January 1943 where he served as Director of Training Plans and Requirements

events.text: Promoted to acting air commodore.

evidence.quote: He was promoted to acting air commodore in January 1943

events.text: Posted to England.

evidence.quote: In 1944 Miller was posted to England

events.text: Took up command of RAF Bomber Command No. 61 Base in North Yorkshire.

evidence.quote: In 1944 Miller was posted to England and on September 19 he took up command

events.text: Substantive rank of air commodore took effect.

evidence.quote: with the substantive rank of air commodore from October 14

events.text: Command redesignated No. 76 Base; Gamston added as subordinate unit.

evidence.quote: On November 9 Millars command was redesignated No . 76 Base

events.text: Took up command of No. 63 Base, responsible for RAF Leeming and Skipton-on-Swale.

evidence.quote: On January 13 , 1945 , Miller took up command of No . 63 Base

events.text: Promoted to Vice-Chief of the Air Staff with rank of air vice-marshal.

evidence.quote: In September 1951 , Miller was promoted to Vice-Chief of the Air Staff with the rank of air vice-marshal

events.text: Ended service as Vice-Chief of the Air Staff.

evidence.quote: serving until 1954

events.text: Gained promotion to air marshal.

evidence.quote: Gaining promotion to air marshal in 1955

events.text: Retired from the RCAF at the request of Prime Minister Louis St. Laurent.

evidence.quote: Gaining promotion to air marshal in 1955 he then retired from the RCAF

events.text: Ended term as Deputy Minister of National Defence.

evidence.quote: remaining in post until 1957

events.text: Appointed Chairman of the Chiefs of Staff.

evidence.quote: In 1960 he was appointed Chairman of the Chiefs of Staff

events.text: Promoted to air chief marshal.

evidence.quote: gaining promotion to air chief marshal on 1 September 1961

events.text: Became the first Chief of the Defence Staff.

evidence.quote: serving from 1964 until 1966

events.text: Ceased as last Chairman of the Chiefs of Staff.

evidence.quote: the last Chairman of the Chiefs of Staff in 1964

events.text: Resigned as Chief of the Defence Staff in protest against unification plans.

evidence.quote: in 1966 resigned in protest , saying he could not in good

events.label: award
events.text: Made a Companion of the Order of Canada.

evidence.quote: In 1972 Miller was made a Companion of the Order of Canada

events.label: death
events.text: Died.

evidence.quote: He died on October 20 , 1997
